name: Comment sheet
summary: A bottom sheet of comments, with people's photos, shown open over a dimmed photo post: the author's replies marked, likes you can toggle, a reply button that fills in the name, and a comment box pinned at the bottom.
use: in a social or video app, for the comments on a post
a11y: The sheet is a labelled modal dialog with a close button, the list scrolls with the keyboard, each like button says its count and state, and Post stays disabled until there is text.

use_when: a phone screen where comments must open over the post without leaving it
avoid_when: comments in a work tool, beside a document or task: use comment-thread
a short confirm or choice over a screen: use confirm-dialog

parts.name: behind
parts.what: the post behind the sheet, dimmed

parts.name: comments
parts.what: one comment: photo, name, an Author tag if it is the poster, time, text, Reply, like count, and any replies under it

parts.name: replies
parts.what: one reply under a comment, with a smaller photo

parts.name: more
parts.what: how many more replies there are

parts.name: like
parts.what: a heart with the like count, pressed or not

parts.name: reply
parts.what: starts a reply to that person

parts.name: input
parts.what: the comment box, next to the viewer's photo

parts.name: post
parts.what: sends the comment; off until there is text

empty.how: with no comments, put an empty-state line ('No comments yet') in the list area and keep the comment box

loading.how: keep the sheet and fill the list with three muted rows the shape of a comment

error.how: if a comment fails to post, keep the text in the box and show a toast-stack message with a retry

disabled.how: Post is off while the box is empty and turns on as soon as there is text

overflow.how: the list scrolls in its own box between the header and the pinned comment box

long_text.how: comment text breaks anywhere so long words and links wrap; names and tags wrap onto a second line

keyboard: Tab reaches Close, the comment list, then each Reply and Like button, View more replies, the comment box and Post
The comment list takes focus, so the arrow keys scroll it
Enter or Space presses the focused button; Like toggles between liked and not
Reply fills the box with @name and moves focus to it
Enter in the comment box posts the comment when it has text; the new comment appears at the top of the list
